history.reason: Judge: not all ACs are testable: AC-001: the outcome is an 'or' between two different results ('gives {}' or 'reads as an empty database'), and it is unclear which the test must assert. A zero-byte gzip file would make json.load raise, so the assertion has to be picked explicitly.; AC-003: the precondition 'a file containing a zero-byte (empty) path' is self-contradictory. It appears to mean a zero-byte file at path p, but as written it cannot be set up unambiguously.
